remarks: Immaculate like new four floor condominium. First floor features Living room with gas fireplace, dining area with sliders to deck. Refinished hardwood flooring on main level. Kitchen with breakfast bar with stainless steel appliances. Powder room. Master bedroom suite with large walk-in closet, full bath with whirlpool tub and shower. Second bedroom also located on second level. Upper level features a den or possible third bedroom.  All bedrooms have new wall-to-wall carpeting. Two car garage with gas heater. Gas hot air heating and central air. No pets please.
